title: Same-frame ESC + left press diverges from the old sequential cancel-then-press behavior (mouse path delta)
detail: Old code cancelled placement BEFORE the press block, so a same-frame ESC+left-press saw placing=-1 (drag-start/UI checks reachable). The mapping evaluates the has_left gates on pre-execution placing (press dropped while placing) and the executor's Cancel re-latches the swallow after the mapping reset — the old drag-start / release-select never happens. Deterministic, scriptable mouse-path delta.
recommended_fix: Mirror the old sequential order: apply the ESC-cancel state (placing=-1 + swallow) inside the mapping before the has_left branch, exactly as esc_cancelled already does for the has_right branch.

title: P + Space same-frame double-toggles the pause (old OR-coalesced to one flip)
evidence:
new (mouse.odin):
			case .P, .Space:
				append(out, Intent(Toggle_Pause{}))
old (patch -):
-	if rl.IsKeyPressed(.P) || rl.IsKeyPressed(.SPACE) {
-		app.mode = .Paused if app.mode == .Run else .Run
-	}
detail: Old pause check was a single || block: one flip per frame regardless of how many of the two keys fired. The mapping appends one Toggle_Pause per key, so a same-frame P+Space chord executes two flips and the mode ends unchanged (Run+P+Space stays Run where the old code paused). Physically rare (<16ms chord) but scriptable and deterministic.
recommended_fix: Coalesce phase-1 keys per frame (emit at most one Toggle_Pause per frame, matching the old || block) or dedupe same-kind intents emitted from one event list.

title: Pad cursor node demolished mid-use: Confirm resolves the dead id to node_pos[0] and pad drawing silently no-ops until the next dpad step
detail: Nothing clears pad_has/pad_node on demolition (only start_run/pad_step do). After the cursor node dies, Confirm's node_world discards node_slot's ok and reads node_pos[0] — a wrong anchor position; validate_draw's Missing_Node blocks the command, so no corruption, but every A press no-ops until a dpad step re-arms the cursor, with no feedback.
recommended_fix: In Confirm (and begin_draw), verify pad_node is still alive via node_slot's ok; when gone, re-arm the cursor (pad_step-style scan) or clear pad_has before proceeding.

title: Pad aim-commit never invokes on_drag_update — the R3 glow preview never lights for pad draws (effect doc says the pad aim step runs it)
detail: drag_retarget and commit_draw call no preview hook, so preview_live stays false from begin_draw and on_draw_commit skips the glow copy — pad draws never light the R3 glow, unlike mouse draws. View-only assist divergence (no command difference); the effect's own doc claims the pad aim step runs it.
recommended_fix: Invoke inp.on_drag_update after drag_retarget in the Confirm aim branch so the preview computes before commit, or amend the effect doc to state pad commits skip the preview.

title: Pad B while placement is armed routes to Cancel_Drag: ghost hidden but placing stays armed, so the next left release places a router
detail: The pad's B is documented as the ESC twin, but while placement is armed every Cursor_Move (per-frame mouse move) sets drag.active = true, so B hits Cancel_Drag: the ghost disappears yet placing stays >= 0, and the next left release commits a router the B-press was meant to cancel. ESC (Cancel) is unaffected; mixed mouse+pad input only.
recommended_fix: Route pad B to Cancel when placing >= 0 (mirror ESC) and keep Cancel_Drag only for the pure draw case: check inp.placing before inp.drag.active in the .B branch.
